in_marathi.name: Avishek
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avishek हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avishek means 'to be worshipped' or 'to be revered'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit root 'Avish' which means 'to worship'. In Hindu tradition, the name Avishek is given to a child who is believed to be a divine being and deserves to be worshipped and revered.
